method: Built independently from render.json wide.records (styles, state, accessible names), the full-page screenshots and a few crops; source locations (inv) were used only to group repeated instances of the same element across scenarios, and every inv was then judged on its rendered style and on what the teacher does with it. KIND: a record gets a kind only if it is itself the visible component; wrappers, labels, text spans inside rows, icons inside buttons, backdrops, dividers, the avatar, the green 'has items' dot, the sliding rail highlight and the A4 paper sheet are null (job then says what the thing is). Inputs that sit inside a painted search box are null and the painted box is the field. Menu items are counted as buttons; menu/popover panels and modal cards are dialog; full-area 'could not load' or 'nothing here' blocks are empty (even when the job is an error), inline banners and status lines are notice. JOB: short Chinese verb phrase for what the teacher accomplishes, taken from visible text plus accessible name (e.g. the pressed '+' whose name is 从草稿卷移出 gets 移出草稿卷; 去找题 and 返回找题 both get 回找题页). LOOK: one id per visual treatment = fill (none / white / tinted / solid colour), border (none / light / dark), corner shape (r4, r8, r12, pill), text colour role (muted grey, ink, red, white-on-dark) and decoration (underline), plus icon-only vs text. Tolerance: same treatment is one look even if font size differs by <=2px, height by <=10px, padding by a few px, or border/text grey differs by <~30 per channel; a different colour role, fill, corner family or underline makes a new look. Resting, hover, disabled, pressed/selected and expanded instances share the look of their resting form (e.g. the proposal vs decided state of the reorder suggestion, the disabled vs enabled 草稿卷 pill). Within-look drift is reported in reviewer-notes.md. The two __seed__ records are injected test controls and get their own looks.
